question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

_________ studies show that students who are not given adequate preparation are prone to failure.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"The"** is a definite article used before singular and plural nouns when the noun is specific or particular. (विशेष)

 
 
• **Example:** **The** book on the table is mine.
 
 
 
• **"Studies"** refers to the act of learning and acquiring knowledge, especially through reading and research. (अध्ययन)
 
 
• **Example:** His **studies **in biology helped him understand the complexities of the human body.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that using **"The" **before **"studies"** specifies the particular studies being referred to.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **An** (एक): An indefinite article used before words that begin with a vowel sound.

 
 
• **Example:** An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
 
 
 
• **Them** (उन्हें): A pronoun used to refer to a group of people or things previously mentioned.
 
 
• **Example:** I saw them at the park yesterday.
 
 
 
• **A** (एक): An indefinite article used before words that begin with a consonant sound.
 
 
• **Example:** A cat is sitting on the fence.
